description: This class implements a Twig extension for sandboxing functionality, allowing to enable or disable sandboxing, check security policies, and validate method/property access within templates.

classes.name: Twig\Extension\SandboxExtension
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractExtension that provides sandboxing features for Twig templates, including enabling/disabling sandbox, security checks, and proxying security policies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SandboxExtension with a security policy, sandboxed state, and optional source policy.

methods.name: getTokenParsers
methods.description: Returns an array containing a SandboxTokenParser instance for parsing sandbox-related tags.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Returns an array containing a SandboxNodeVisitor instance for traversing and modifying the AST during sandboxing.

methods.name: enableSandbox
methods.description: Enables sandboxing for the current context.

methods.name: disableSandbox
methods.description: Disables sandboxing for the current context.

methods.name: isSandboxed
methods.description: Checks if sandboxing is active globally, locally, or via source policy.

methods.name: isSandboxedGlobally
methods.description: Returns whether sandboxing is globally enabled.

methods.name: setSecurityPolicy
methods.description: Sets a new security policy for the sandbox extension.

methods.name: checkSecurity
methods.description: Checks the security of tags, filters, and functions within the sandbox environment.

methods.name: checkMethodAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a method call on an object is allowed under the security policy.

methods.name: checkPropertyAllowed
methods.description: Checks if property access on an object is allowed under the security policy.

methods.name: ensureToStringAllowed
methods.description: Ensures that an object (or array of objects) is allowed to be cast to string according to sandbox policies.

methods.name: ensureToStringAllowedForArray
methods.description: Recursively checks array elements to ensure they are safe for string conversion.
